 This is what you need to know if you are a truck driver… or want to become one 
Of course: you spend a lot of time on the road and transport (often) goods from A to B. But behind that steering wheel lies a profession where responsibility, independence, and craftsmanship come together. Whether you are just starting or have been driving for years: this is what you need to know as a truck driver. You are the business card on wheels 
As a driver, you represent not only yourself, but also your employer and the client. You are present on customer sites, at loading and unloading locations, and sometimes even at private addresses. A professional attitude, clear communication, and keeping agreements are therefore just as important as good driving skills. Safety always comes first 
Safe working as a professional driver is not a side issue. You deal with heavy vehicles, changing weather conditions, and busy traffic. Knowing and respecting driving and rest time regulations is essential, as is correctly securing cargo. Even small things, such as getting in and out safely, staying alert when reversing, and paying attention to blind spots, make a big difference. If you want to refresh this knowledge, you can consider the training 'Updating professional competence for drivers'. This also falls under the Code 95 regulation. 
In addition, it is important not only to drive safely, but also to know how to act when something goes wrong. Training such as first aid (EHBO), emergency response (BHV), and VCA provides practical knowledge about working safely, recognizing risks, and acting correctly in case of incidents.  Beschrijving Samenvatting Step into the world of logistics as an Orderpicker at Albert Heijn. This is your chance to join a dynamic team, develop your skills, and enjoy real growth opportunities in a modern warehouse environment. Good work! Over de functie 
As an Orderpicker at Albert Heijn Bleiswijk, you play a vital role in keeping the online orders running smoothly. Your daily routine includes picking orders with a handheld scanner, checking the quality of products, and managing stock levels. With the scanner, you'll see exactly which item goes to which location, scan barcodes, and ensure every order is accurate. You'll work in a modern warehouse, often in cool conditions to keep products fresh. The environment is lively, with team members supporting each other to get the job done. 
Your main tasks are: - Picking online orders using a scanner; - Checking order quality before shipment; - Managing and organizing stock in the warehouse; - Following clear location and barcode systems; - Collaborating with your team to meet daily targets. 
You'll work in a 3-shift system: - Morningshift: 06:00 - 14:30; - Afternoonshift: 14:30 - 23:00; - Nightshift: 23:00 - 06:00. Over het bedrijf 
You will be working at the Albert Heijn warehouse in Bleiswijk, where groceries are collected and prepared for shipment on a daily basis. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that orders are processed accurately and on time. You will join a diverse team where colleagues help one another and work together to achieve daily goals. Naturally, you won't be on your own as a new team member; you will receive guidance from a buddy to help you quickly learn the ropes and find your place within the team.
